decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains a flagship of the firm's automation offer, and without a performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search, though some risk of consolidation with the single-function robots remains.
The automatic de-shuttering robot is a modular part of integrated plant solutions, and slack from industry growth lets the firm keep carrying it.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in automated pallet circulation, and results at aspiration give no reason to withdraw it.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's automation strategy and fits its engineering strengths, so it stays.
The newly launched multi-model magazining, cleaning and plotting line extends the established offer and is too young to judge against aspiration.
The production analysis software supports the firm's digital and lifecycle-service direction at low carrying cost, so management keeps it while results develop.
